title: For buildd image build process the apt-get dist-upgrade in
description:
For buildd image build process the apt-get dist-upgrade in
52-linux-virtual-image.binary hook can add a machine-id if
systemd has updates in the updates pocket. Hence we need to
truncate it.

Detailed bug information in LP: #2175078
https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/livecd-rootfs/+bug/2175078

Testing:
Tested it by building a buildd image locally and checking 
for the value inside /etc/machine-id

==> Entering chroot ...
root@allen-X1-Carbon:/# cat /etc/machine-id 
root@allen-X1-Carbon:/#
diff:
diff --git a/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary b/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary
index 07a401f..98ad8a9 100755
--- a/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary
+++ b/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary
@@ -76,6 +76,12 @@ env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive chroot "$mount_d" apt-get \
 
 create_manifest $mount_d "livecd.$PROJECT.disk-linux-virtual.manifest"
 
+# The `dist-upgrade` a few lines above might update systemd, which in turn
+# writes a machine-id to this file. We need to clear it so that each instance 
+# gets its own machine-id on boot.
+truncate -s 0 "$mount_d/etc/machine-id"
+rm -f "$mount_d/var/lib/dbus/machine-id"
+
 # unmount disk image to prevent corruption
 # and remove it so the trap doesn't try to unmount it again
 umount_disk_image $mount_d
